description: This is an XML configuration/source file defining simple methods for website services within the OFBiz framework, including functions for retrieving website path aliases, creating website content, and generating missing SEO URLs.

methods.name: getWebSitePathAlias
methods.description: Returns a WebSite Path Alias based on provided lookup parameters.

methods.name: quickCreateWebSiteContent
methods.description: Automatically creates website CMS content for a specified website, supporting both single and multiple content types.

methods.name: generateMissingSeoUrlForWebsite
methods.description: Generates missing SEO URLs for categories, products, and content associated with a website, updating URL data and reporting summaries.
